hotel_name: Saltstayz Select - Near Sohna Road City Center

positive_snippets: Really nice and decent hotel with a comfortable atmosphere. The rooms were clean and organized, and the service was quick and professional. Staff members were helpful and well-behaved. I especially liked the breakfast — good quality and variety. Overall, a smooth and satisfying experience.

I recently stayed at this hotel and had a wonderful experience. The staff were warm and welcoming, the rooms were spotless, and the food exceeded expectations. The location is perfect, with easy access to key attractions. Excellent service, comfortable stay, and great value—highly recommend this hotel for a memorable trip!

We had a great stay at Salt Stayz. The room was spacious and immaculately clean, with a comfortable bed and all the amenities we needed. The staff was incredibly polite and attentive, always ready to assist with a smile. The location is excellent, making it easy to access local attractions and the metro. The food was a particular highlight—delicious and with a great variety. We would definitely recommend this hotel for its excellent service and welcoming atmosphere.
negative_snippets: Not recommended at all. The room was full of cockroaches, and hygiene was terrible. No water bottles were provided—only dusty glass bottles filled with unclean water. There were no toiletries or dental kits available. The room hadn’t been cleaned properly, and the staff’s response to complaints was very poor. Overall, a very disappointing experience.
